_meta.role: Systems Engineer - Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Hardware & Integration

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with hands-on experience integrating sensors, firmware, and embedded hardware across robotics and autonomous-systems projects. Background spans STM32 bare-metal firmware, UART/I2C sensor communication, PCB design and BOM documentation, and troubleshooting hardware-software integration issues on deployed robotic and simulated autonomous-vehicle platforms. Comfortable working hands-on with vendor hardware, Python and shell scripting for diagnostics, and cross-team technical collaboration.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI based real time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.

Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove for hands free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25 member robotics team across national level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end to end.
Designed and fabricated custom single layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed loop feedback.
Organized 10+ exhibitions and technical workshops covering Arduino, PCB design, and SolidWorks.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real time data acquisition and visualization; used GitLab and JupyterHub for version control and technical documentation.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending multi servo PWM control commands to STM32 over interrupt driven UART with user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n and fine tuned UFLD for an adaptive control stack with lane following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation - 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop - Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon - National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
